steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The main sources of law in England and Wales are statute law, common law, delegated legislation and international treaties | Key Fact: Statute law is made by Parliament — Acts of Parliament are the highest form of domestic law | Key Fact: Common law is developed through judicial decisions — judges interpret statutes and create law in new areas | Key Fact: Delegated legislation is law made by bodies authorised by Parliament (e.g. statutory instruments, by-laws)
